name: safety-and-reliability-skills
description: High-hazard-industry methods transplanted to operations and software: checklist design (read-do/do-confirm, killer items), bowtie barrier analysis with HAZOP guidewords, SBAR/I-PASS structured communication with PACE assertiveness, reliability engineering math (Weibull, MTBF, availability), and weight-of-the-books design-basis load review (the Load Manifest: size systems against the payload they exist to carry).
